walkthroughs.body_html:
£60 in ratio 2:3.

Total parts = 5. One part = 60 ÷ 5 = 12. Shares: 2 × 12 = £24 and 3 × 12 = £36.

Direct: 4 apples cost £2; 12 apples cost £6.

Inverse: 4 workers take 6 days. 12 workers take 6 × 4 ÷ 12 = 2 days.

Speed = distance ÷ time. 120 km in 2 h → 60 km/h.

Density = mass ÷ volume. 150 g in 50 cm³ → 3 g/cm³. Pressure = force ÷ area.

free_texts.q: What is distance ÷ time called? One word, lowercase.
